description: Meta-analysis of SLC40A1 Q248H allele frequency across African cohorts and effect sizes for iron-related outcomes in African iron overload
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# --- SLC40A1 Q248H (rs11568350, c.744G>T, p.Gln248His) allele frequency across reported cohorts ---
# n = number of individuals genotyped; af = Q248H allele frequency
rows = [
 # label, region, group, n_individuals, allele_freq, source PMID
 ("African-Americans (aggregate, 4 cohorts)","USA","Diaspora",1038,0.0525,"17490902"),
 ("Native SE Africans (aggregate, 2 cohorts)","SE Africa","Native",259,0.0946,"17490902"),
 ("Sao Tome e Principe","West Africa","Native",115,0.022,"21231898"),
 ("Angola","West/Central Africa","Native",156,0.035,"21231898"),
 ("Republic of Guinea","West Africa","Native",170,0.041,"21231898"),
 ("Botswana (healthy adults)","Southern Africa","Native",174,0.089,"25744489"),
 ("DR Congo, South Kivu (children <5y)","Central Africa","Native",1071,0.0588,"36060466"),
 ("Botswana (malaria cases)","Southern Africa","Native",183,0.08,"34534526"),
 ("Botswana (malaria controls)","Southern Africa","Native",81,0.08,"34534526"),
 ("Zimbabwe community controls (SF<400)","Southern Africa","Native",51,7/51/2,"14636642"),
 ("Anonymous African-Americans","USA","Diaspora",100,5/100/2,"14636642"),
]
df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["cohort","region","group","n","af","pmid"])
# binomial SE on allele counts (2n alleles)
df["alleles"] = 2*df["n"]
df["se"] = np.sqrt(df.af*(1-df.af)/df.alleles)
df["lo"] = np.clip(df.af-1.96*df.se,0,1); df["hi"] = df.af+1.96*df.se

def meta(sub):
    w = 1/sub.se**2
    fe = (w*sub.af).sum()/w.sum()
    Q  = (w*(sub.af-fe)**2).sum(); dfree = len(sub)-1
    tau2 = max(0,(Q-dfree)/(w.sum()-(w**2).sum()/w.sum()))
    wr = 1/(sub.se**2+tau2)
    re = (wr*sub.af).sum()/wr.sum(); se_re = np.sqrt(1/wr.sum())
    I2 = max(0,(Q-dfree)/Q)*100 if Q>0 else 0
    return re, se_re, Q, dfree, I2

nat = df[df.group=="Native"]; dia = df[df.group=="Diaspora"]
re_n = meta(nat); re_d = meta(dia); re_a = meta(df)
z = (re_n[0]-re_d[0])/np.sqrt(re_n[1]**2+re_d[1]**2); p = 2*(1-stats.norm.cdf(abs(z)))

print("Random-effects pooled Q248H allele frequency")
print(f"  Native sub-Saharan African  : {re_n[0]*100:.2f}% (95% CI {100*(re_n[0]-1.96*re_n[1]):.2f}-{100*(re_n[0]+1.96*re_n[1]):.2f}), I2={re_n[4]:.0f}%, k={len(nat)}")
print(f"  African diaspora (US)       : {re_d[0]*100:.2f}% (95% CI {100*(re_d[0]-1.96*re_d[1]):.2f}-{100*(re_d[0]+1.96*re_d[1]):.2f}), I2={re_d[4]:.0f}%, k={len(dia)}")
print(f"  All cohorts                 : {re_a[0]*100:.2f}% (95% CI {100*(re_a[0]-1.96*re_a[1]):.2f}-{100*(re_a[0]+1.96*re_a[1]):.2f}), I2={re_a[4]:.0f}%, k={len(df)}")
print(f"  Native vs diaspora: z={z:.2f}, p={p:.4f}")
print()
# Hardy-Weinberg expected carrier/homozygote burden at pooled native frequency
q = re_n[0]
print(f"At q={q:.4f}: expected heterozygotes {2*q*(1-q)*100:.1f}%, homozygotes {q*q*100:.3f}% (1 in {1/(q*q):.0f})")

# --- Q248H-associated risk of non-HFE iron overload (Barton 2007, PMID 17490902) ---
ors = {"African-Americans":(1.57,0.52,4.72),"Native Africans":(1.05,0.28,3.94)}
lnor = np.array([np.log(v[0]) for v in ors.values()])
selnor = np.array([(np.log(v[2])-np.log(v[1]))/(2*1.96) for v in ors.values()])
w = 1/selnor**2; pooled = (w*lnor).sum()/w.sum(); se_p = np.sqrt(1/w.sum())
print(f"\nPooled OR for iron overload given Q248H = {np.exp(pooled):.2f} (95% CI {np.exp(pooled-1.96*se_p):.2f}-{np.exp(pooled+1.96*se_p):.2f}), p={2*(1-stats.norm.cdf(abs(pooled/se_p))):.3f}")

# --- Figure ---
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(13,5.6), gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.5,1]})
ax = axes[0]
d = df.sort_values(["group","af"])
colors = {"Native":"#2a6f97","Diaspora":"#b5651d"}
y = np.arange(len(d))
ax.errorbar(d.af*100, y, xerr=[(d.af-d.lo)*100,(d.hi-d.af)*100], fmt='o',
            ecolor='grey', elinewidth=1.2, capsize=3, mfc='none', ls='none',
            mec=[colors[g] for g in d.group][0])
for yi,(_,r) in zip(y, d.iterrows()):
    ax.plot(r.af*100, yi, 'o', color=colors[r.group], ms=4+np.sqrt(r.n)/4)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{c} (n={n})" for c,n in zip(d.cohort,d.n)], fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(re_n[0]*100, color=colors["Native"], ls='--', lw=1.3, label=f"Native pooled {re_n[0]*100:.1f}%")
ax.axvline(re_d[0]*100, color=colors["Diaspora"], ls='--', lw=1.3, label=f"Diaspora pooled {re_d[0]*100:.1f}%")
ax.set_xlabel("SLC40A1 Q248H allele frequency (%)")
ax.set_title("Q248H (rs11568350) is a common African polymorphism,\nabsent in Europeans", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc='lower right'); ax.grid(axis='x', alpha=.3)

ax2 = axes[1]
# Effect sizes reported for iron-related outcomes
eff = [("Death from HCC,\nhighest hepatic iron grade\n(Strachan necropsy, n=604)",23.5,2.1,225),
       ("Death from tuberculosis,\nhighest splenic iron grade\n(n=604)",16.9,4.8,59.9),
       ("HCC with hepatocellular\niron 3-4+ (Zimbabwe, n=215)",3.1,1.05,9.4),
       ("Iron overload given Q248H,\nAfrican-Americans",1.57,0.52,4.72),
       ("Iron overload given Q248H,\nNative Africans",1.05,0.28,3.94)]
yy = np.arange(len(eff))[::-1]
for yi,(lab,o,lo,hi) in zip(yy,eff):
    ax2.plot([lo,hi],[yi,yi],color='grey',lw=1.4)
    ax2.plot(o,yi,'s',color='#9d0208' if lo>1 else '#6c757d',ms=7)
ax2.axvline(1,color='k',lw=.8)
ax2.set_xscale('log'); ax2.set_yticks(yy); ax2.set_yticklabels([e[0] for e in eff], fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xlabel("Odds ratio (log scale)")
ax2.set_title("Tissue iron load, not Q248H genotype,\ncarries the clinical risk", fontsize=10)
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
